label.description: 1 to 64 characters of ASCII letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, starting with a letter or digit.

path.description: An absolute path, or one beginning `~/`, which resolves against HOME. No empty, `.` or `..` component and no trailing `/`. UTF-8 without U+0000-U+001F, U+007F-U+009F, U+2028, U+2029, `"` or `\`.

secretRef.description: A reference to a secret; never its value (ADR-0049 D4). v1 delivers `file`. `keychain` and `vault` are reserved: a v1 binary refuses them by name (`secret-ref-not-delivered`). Any other key is `unknown-key`; a string, number, array or other object in a secret field is `secret-inlined`.

urlPrefix.description: A keystore URL or URL prefix: a lowercase scheme, `://`, then printable ASCII without space, `"` or `\`. At most 2048 bytes.

description: The deployment configuration of `leyline-sign-helper` (ADR-0019, ADR-0049). Deny by default: `auth.required` and `signAllow.required` default to true. Rules this schema cannot state, and which the parser enforces (README "Rules"): a key twice in one object, a JSON escape in a string, a non-canonical or non-loopback bind, a duplicate set entry, `sign-allow-required`, and the host checks (`caller-tokens-required` reads the caller-tokens file).

callerTokens.description: A file holding the bearer tokens as `name=token,...`. Replaces LEYLINE_SIGN_CALLER_TOKENS.

required.description: Refuse to start without a non-empty caller map (`caller-tokens-required`). Dev mode states false. Replaces --require-auth (whose default was false).

bind.description: The loopback socket address the helper listens on (ADR-0019 requirement 2): `127.x.y.z:port` or `[::1]:port`, port 1-65535. Replaces --bind.

probeUrl.description: The keystore URL `/healthz?deep=1` resolves. `null`: deep health reports unconfigured. Replaces LEYLINE_SIGN_HEALTHZ_PROBE_URL.

rateLimitPerSecond.description: Per-UID signatures per second (ADR-0019 requirement 10). Replaces --rate-limit.

resolveAllow.description: URL prefixes `/resolve` may serve. A set; empty denies all. A prefix that would authorize a signing-key URL is refused at start. Replaces LEYLINE_SIGN_RESOLVE_ALLOW.

ttlMs.description: `null`: per scheme (60000 for op:// and apple-password://, 0 otherwise). Replaces LEYLINE_SIGN_RESOLVE_TTL_MS.

callers.description: Caller label to the URL prefixes it may ask `/sign` for. Each list is a set. Replaces LEYLINE_SIGN_SIGN_ALLOW.

required.description: Refuse to start unless some caller has a non-empty prefix list (`sign-allow-required`). Replaces --require-sign-allow (whose default was false).

opBin.description: The `op` binary. `null`: op:// is unavailable. Replaces LEYLINE_SIGN_OP_BIN.

securityBin.description: The `security` binary. `null`: apple-password:// is unavailable. Replaces LEYLINE_SIGN_SECURITY_BIN.
